definitions.name: O3B.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'O3B.DX' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD O3B.DX GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest number of brackets open at once (running count, floored at 0)

definitions.name: O3B.PREFIX
definitions.body: G0A.BSCAN 'O3B.PS' BIND [ '#' ] O3B.PS CONCAT 'O3B.PT' BIND O3B.PT O1A.IDX 0 O3B.PT [ '#' EQ ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 for none)

definitions.name: O3B.FILLED
definitions.body: 'O3B.FV' BIND O3B.FV O3B.FV O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ G0B.FILLSTEP ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> forward-filled Vector, leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: O3B.UNPRICED
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'O3B.UX' BIND O3B.UX 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> distinct skus of orders lacking a price, first-appearance order

definitions.name: O3B.TAGCOUNTS
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'O3B.TX' BIND O3B.TX 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record tag -> number of orders carrying it
